**Finding submitted: deviation (AUDIT), confidence 0.72.**

- **Where:** § 11.3 "Suspected Violations" (p0132, p0137, p0138). The agreement contains no clause using the word "audit"; the only inspection-type right binding us is IBM's reservation of "the right to investigate potential violations" of the AUP warranty in § 11.2(b), backed by our obligation in p0138 to hand over "all relevant information" on IBM's request.
- **Why it deviates:** No frequency cap, no advance notice (p0137's notice is only a best-efforts attempt before IBM restricts access or removes Content, not before an investigation), no business-hours limit, no independent-auditor/confidentiality requirement, no cost allocation, and no bar on access to our systems. Unlimited/unannounced audits fall at the playbook walk-away line.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** Inserted a single proviso after p0137 imposing the preferred position — one investigation per 12 months, 30 days' prior written notice, our normal business hours, IBM or an independent auditor bound by the AECI, IBM bearing all costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct or remote access to our systems, with off-site information delivery permitted. IBM's substantive remedies in 11.3(a)–(d) are untouched, and the comment flags the 15-day/10% fallback.
